content:
I don’t typically install macOS developer betas outside of the big releases, but I decided to install the 27.3 developer beta to check out Safari’s vertical tabs. I don’t know how much they will be building them out, but I don’t like their implementation so far. For one, I don’t like them being persistent. I love the auto-hiding capabilities that Arc and Dia have. I keep A LOT of tabs open at all times and while I would love to use Safari as my main browser, the inability to hide tabs is a deal breaker for me. So I’m not sure where that leaves me.

I was a big fan of Arc, which is being put out to pasture next month. I’ve been using Dia and like it ok, but I’ve come to the point where I don’t want a browser with AI built-in. if I’m going to use AI in a browser (and sometimes I do), I want to use Claude or ChatGPT, both of which I pay for and use daily. Seems like my choices are Zen (Firefox), which I have tried and don’t like and Vivaldi, which everyone seems mention, is way too bloated. Might just have to stick with Dia if I’m set on using a Chromium-based browser as my daily driver.
